{
  "title": "Image Meta Data Removal",
  "body": "This feature request is for an option to remove meta data from a picture being shared in a conversation to prevent location, device and other key data being shared.\r\n\r\n",
  "state": "closed",
  "closed_at": "2018-04-03T00:52:09Z",
  "updated_at": "2018-04-03T00:52:12Z"
}

    "id": 267796688,
    "html_url": "https://github.com/signalapp/Signal-Android/issues/5968#issuecomment-267796688",
    "body": "Isn't this how it already is?\r\nI just tested this with three images: a picture taken with the direct camera, another one with the attachment drawer camera and the last one by attaching a picture taken with the system camera. None of them had any metadata.",
    "created_at": "2016-12-18T00:55:56Z",
    "updated_at": "2016-12-18T00:55:56Z"
  },
  {
    "id": 267800377,
    "html_url": "https://github.com/signalapp/Signal-Android/issues/5968#issuecomment-267800377",
    "body": "I think it happens incidentally at the moment because of image scaling, but if an image were small enough to be sent without scaling or compression, I'm not sure the metadata would be removed.",

    "body": "Can confirm, after exporting an image, there is no metadata except for the megapixels and the time it was saved to the device (not capture time).",

    "id": 268072211,
    "html_url": "https://github.com/signalapp/Signal-Android/issues/5968#issuecomment-268072211",
    "body": "I took a small picture and sent it to another phone. I exported the picture on the same phone from which I sent it and the metadata were still there.\r\nSo this issue seems valid to me.\r\n\r\nEDIT: The small picture's metadata are also present on the receiving phone.",
    "created_at": "2016-12-19T20:40:21Z",

  },
  {
    "id": 317740592,
    "html_url": "https://github.com/signalapp/Signal-Android/issues/5968#issuecomment-317740592",
    "body": "I can confirm that on Android EXIF data is **not** removed in many cases. Including the simplest one of \"I'll attach a photo to a group chat.\"\r\n\r\n### Bug description\r\nI sent a photo from my camera to a group chat. I then thought to myself \"Does Signal strip EXIF data?\" So I asked someone in the group chat to check. They extracted my phone's model, date/time information, and the GPS coordinates from the EXIF data.\r\n\r\n### Steps to reproduce\r\n- Send a photo\r\n- Extract EXIF Data\r\n\r\n**Actual result:** EXIF Data is maintained when I send a photo\r\n**Expected result:** I would expect Signal to do the 'safe' thing by default which would be at a minimum to strip geolocation data.\r\n\r\nObviously geolocation data is *extremely* sensitive (it's extremely common to take photos in your own home) and in many or most cases one does not want to share their home address with all the individuals one may wish to send a picture to.\r\n\r\n### Device info\r\n**Signal version:** 4.8.1",
    "created_at": "2017-07-25T13:40:56Z",
    "updated_at": "2017-07-25T13:40:56Z"
  },
